notes.title: Patchy Patchy
notes.content:
I've only gone and done one of those patches 

- Changed some particle effects to better support modern gpus
- Long animations will play at increased speeds above Ace Level 2
- each ace level will now add 6 meters to the Final Artifact
- visual indicator when there are ten crates on the board and you are on the crate bomb quest
- fixed bug with crate bomb lag
- purchasing all items at Leem's arcanery unlocks a secret +300% spell damage bonus
- Shock and Freeze time now scale based on a function of spell damage bonus
- fixed visual sorting artifacts with semi-transparent sprites
- fixed an issue with achievements not working
- rebalanced some earlier quests that were a bit of a difficulty spike but werent intended to be

I had to update the engine version which ended up being a pretty big deal, I think I've squished all the bugs, but If i've missed anything please drop in the discord and let me know :) [url=discord.gg/eightyeightgames]discord.gg/eightyeightgames[/url]

notes.title: A New Update
notes.content:
Been a while, hasn't it, old friend.

I added a couple of cool things, more skins to unlock in the daily challenge mode, oh and a skin manager so you can choose your skins too.

I added Spanish to localization which is pretty neat, but generally lots of little bugfixes. let me know if I've broke anything!

Sorry it's taken so long. I've been making my new game Photographs, Its very different to my usual stuff in some ways, but very similar in others. Take a look and add it to your wishlist if you like what you see

 [url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008920/Photographs/[/url]

tags.feature: - more skins to unlock in the daily challenge mode
- oh and a skin manager so you can choose your skins too.
- I added Spanish to localization which is pretty neat

tags.bug: - but generally lots of little bugfixes.

notes.title: You Must Build A Boat 1.2
notes.content:
One day Jim was walking down the road.

Houses passed by as he sauntered along, and before he knew it he reached a fork in the road. Betwixt the fork lay a sign.

To the left it read "CERTAIN DEATH"

To the right it read "PATCH NOTES"

Jim was no fool. he took the path to the right.

The road turned to a dirt track, and then, not even that, but Jim carried on anyway.

He was forced to stop as a large stone blocked his way. Runes were etched upon it. Jim peered at the arcane writings, but managed to figure out a few words

- New Daily Challenge Mode - After finishing the game, get a new dungeon generated each day.
- New Skin Unlocks - Complete daily challenges to unlock new skins for your crew.
- Aces Wild - Increasing Ace levels now has much more effect than it used to.
- Localisation - Now you can build a boat in your favourite language
- Fast Cycle - You don’t have to do the tutorial again an Ace reset
- Bug fixes: Fixed lots of them
- Typos - Fixed the more embarrassing ones

"Interesting." said Jim.
